# HyperMoto vendor integration

This is the reserved location for original HyperMoto product configuration and vendor-side integration.

Do not place proprietary Motorola firmware, Google applications, Google Play services, or third-party APKs here unless redistribution is explicitly authorized. Track licenses and provenance for every imported component.

Planned integration includes product branding, default configuration, overlays, and optional licensed service packages. No vendor implementation exists yet.
